bounties.flavor: A small number of oozing creatures have been spotted near the outer trails. Travelers report slick residue on the stones.
A gathering of slimes has taken hold along the forest road. Merchants are refusing the route until the threat is cleared.
A large group of the creatures has colonized the old waystation. The guild considers this an urgent culling.
A few of the glutinous things have crept into the fen paths. Locals say the water tastes wrong near the crossing.
A sizable cluster of slimes has settled in the marsh hollows. Trappers have lost more than one snare to the muck.
A large group of slimes thrives in the deeper fen. Something is drawing them together — the guild wants answers and fewer of them.
A handful of slimes have been sighted on the ridge approach. Few hunters go that way willingly, which is why we're posting this.
A troubling mass of the creatures has spread across the ridge shelf. The last party to scout it did not linger to count them.
A great seething host of slimes blankets the upper ridge. This is not a nuisance — it is an infestation. The guild pays well for resolution.
A few dark slimes have been spotted lurking near the outer trails. They scatter when alone but grow bold when gathered — approach with caution.
A pack of the darker variety has taken root along the forest road. Witnesses say they coordinate in ways ordinary slimes do not.
A large colony of pack slimes has overrun the waystation approach. Do not engage without provocation — they will respond in force.
A handful of pack slimes has appeared in the fen. Each one alone is docile, but they have a habit of finding each other quickly.
A cluster of the dangerous dark slimes has settled in the marsh hollows. Strike fast — disturbing one rouses all of them.
A swarming colony of pack slimes has overtaken the deeper fen. In those numbers they show no fear. The guild urges extreme caution.
A small group of dark slimes patrols the ridge approach. They appear passive until disturbed — do not test them.
A coordinated group of dark slimes holds the ridge shelf. Split them apart and they may hold — but attack one and expect the rest to follow.
A dense pack of the dark variety blankets the upper ridge. The guild has had two failed culling attempts already. Pay is accordingly generous.
A handful of the largest slimes have been sighted near the outer trails. They do not flee. Experienced hunters only.
A cluster of the great slimes has established itself on the forest road. Caravans refuse passage. The guild posts hazard pay.
A full infestation of the largest slime breed has seized the waystation. The guild will not post this bounty twice — clear it or abandon the route.
Several large slimes have moved into the fen. Unlike their smaller kin, these pursue on sight. Travel the path armed.
A dangerous concentration of the largest slime type has spread across the marsh. The guild marks this urgent.
The largest slimes have been spotted on the ridge approach. They are territorial and relentless. This posting is not for novices.
A great host of the apex slime variety holds the upper ridge. The guild has exhausted all other options. Bring skill and patience.
